sessions.title: Become immediately effective with PowerShell
sessions.description:
IT pros, admins, and help desk staff, come learn ways to automate redundant tasks and manage your environment at scale. Do you keep hearing how all your IT problems can be solved with PowerShell, but don't know where to start or how to use the solutions already available?

This workshop teaches you how to become immediately effective in PowerShell.

sessions.title: Jumpstart Your Power BI Skills: A Handson Workshop
sessions.description:
Power BI is a powerful tool for building analytical solutions. But like any tool, getting started can be tough. In this one-day hands-on workshop, we’ll work through sample datasets and reports to help you get comfortable using Power Query, DAX, relationships, and modeling—the building blocks of solid Power BI reports.

A laptop is a must.  More than half of this workshop will be hands-on, where you’ll build a report from scratch. You’ll pull in data from a source I’ll provide, clean and correct the data, and step through the process of creating a functional Power BI report. By the end of the session, you’ll have built something tangible that you can take with you and apply to your own work.

This practical, no-fluff session will cover:

🔹 Getting Data into Power BI – Connecting to different data sources and cleaning messy data with Power Query  
🔹 Building a Data Model – Setting up relationships, calculated columns, and learning basic DAX  
🔹 Creating Reports & Dashboards – Designing clear, interactive visuals that actually help people make decisions  
🔹 Publishing & Sharing – Understanding how to refresh and share your reports with others

Who Should Attend?

✔ Data Professionals – SQL Developers, Data Engineers, BI Analysts  
✔ Business Analysts – Excel users who want to move beyond static spreadsheets  
✔ Anyone looking for a practical way to start using Power BI

What You’ll Need:

 Bring Your Laptop! This is a hands-on session. Please have Power BI Desktop (latest version) installed. No prior Power BI experience required, but basic familiarity with data concepts (like tables and filters) will help.

By the end of the day, you’ll have:  
✅ Built your first Power BI report using real-world data  
✅ A better understanding of Power Query, DAX, and modeling  
✅ Resources to keep learning after the session

sessions.title: Hashing: The Cornerstone of Blockchain Security and Data Integrity
sessions.description: In the digital world, ensuring data integrity and security is paramount, and one of the key tools used to achieve this is hashing. A hash function takes an input, such as a message or file, and returns a fixed-size string of bytes, typically a digest that appears random. This output, or hash value, is unique to each input, making it a fundamental building block in various areas of computer science, including data security, blockchain technology, and password storage. Programmatic hashing examples will be provided in Python.

sessions.title: How to Diagnose a Slow Power BI Report
sessions.description:
Users complain that a Power BI report is so slow that it is not worth using. A Power BI report may not perform well for many reasons, but how do you know where to start? In this session, I will show you some of the main tools I use to dive deep into the common and the not-so-common performance issues I run into. Starting from a slow report, we will learn how to diagnose where the problem is. Beginning with Performance Analyzer in Power BI, we can start to figure out where the issue is. Is it the visual that is slow, or are the DAX queries taking too long? 

Next, we will use DAX Studio to tune the DAX queries that are being generated. Along the way, we will look beneath the visuals to see how Power BI is architected so we can better understand how to write better code from the start. We will examine Query Plans and Server Timings to evaluate which of our changes are more beneficial. 

 Lastly, we will examine methods for detecting and preventing performance issues before they occur. Using Tabular Editor, we will learn how Best Practice Analyzer can detect performance issues with your semantic models.

sessions.title: Leadership Principles Uncovered...
sessions.description: There are many Managers in this world and every once in a while we come across a leaders.  We will go on a Journey as to what is a leader and what we can do to improve our ability to stay ahead of the curve and become a better leader.

sessions.title: PowerShell Progression: From One-liners to Advanced Functions
sessions.description: Join me as we explore the progression of PowerShell. Starting with a simple console command, we’ll show you how to enhance your scripts and transition to functions, culminating in an Advanced Function. Along the way, I'll share best practices to help you advance your PowerShell skills. This presentation is suitable for beginners and intermediate users.

sessions.title: Rapid Prototyping in the Age of AI
sessions.description: AI has been a major factor in the field of Application Development. Now, with the ability to rapidly put something in front of a client, this changes the game completely. We'll talk through what that looks like and how to embrace this change.

sessions.title: Business Continuity in Azure SQL Databases
sessions.description:
Azure SQL Database is a cloud-based relational database service that offers high availability, scalability, and performance for your applications. But what is the correct service tier when it comes to business continuity for your workload and budget? 

In this session, you will learn about the differences and trade-offs between the General Purpose and Business Critical service tiers in terms of Failover Clustering, Always On Availability, and Zone-Redundant capabilities. Whether you are new to Azure SQL Database or an experienced user, this session will help you understand and leverage the business continuity options that Azure SQL Database offers.

sessions.title: High speed failover Clustering with RDMA/ROCE with Hyper-v over converged multigigabit networks
sessions.description:
A session going over the design, Architecture and benefit of RDMA and ROCEv2 with Storage Spaces direct and hyper-v to create high speed, GPU accelerated desktops for end users.
Cluster nodes can be at different sites and local to the site.  Requires multi/gigabit converged Ethernet and QoS enabled switches.
I have Visio diagrams, slide shows of specific screens.  Also includes demo of active system and install tips and tricks.

sessions.title: Streamlining DataOps in Fabric: Implementing Azure DevOps CI/CD Pipelines for Fabric SQL DB
sessions.description: Ensuring efficient, consistent, and reliable deployment processes is crucial for maintaining robust, enterprise-ready data solutions. In this session, I will share insights on creating Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using Azure DevOps for the Fabric SQL DB. Attendees will learn how to leverage Azure DevOps to streamline their development workflows, enhance collaboration, and ensure high-quality data delivery. By the end of this presentation, participants will have a comprehensive understanding of how to implement and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support their organization's data infrastructure needs.

sessions.title: Identify Poorly Performing Queries - Three Tools You Already Own
sessions.description: One of the first challenges you’ll face when you decide to address poor query performance is identifying which query you should focus on. While you can simply wait for the people using your application to complain, a more proactive approach will serve you better. This session will walk you through three different, built-in tools within SQL Server that can be used to identify poorly performing queries. We’ll focus on the ubiquitous Dynamic Management Views (DMVs) since you can use them anywhere. Then, we’ll talk about what’s possible in SQL Server 2012 and greater through the use of Extended Events. Finally, we’ll talk about how you can put Query Store to use if you’re working in SQL Server 2016 or greater. Between these three tools, you can better understand which queries you need to focus on to fix problems in your environment right away.

sessions.title: Applying Forensic Accounting Techniques using SQL and Python
sessions.description: Forensic accountants and fraud examiners use a range of techniques to uncover fraudulent journal entries and illegal activities. As data professionals, most of us will never unravel a Bernie Madoff scheme, but we can apply these same techniques in our own environments to uncover dirty data. This session will use a combination of SQL Server and Python to apply these fraud detection techniques, which include Benford's Law, outlier analysis, time series analysis, and cohort analysis.

sessions.title: How to Manage Recruiters and Hiring Managers in the Job Search
sessions.description:
How to Manage Recruiters and Hiring Managers in the Job Search: A Recruiter's Guide to Negotiating, Nailing Interviews, and Speeding up Timelines to Land the Ideal Role

In this 60 minute session, I would cover general advice and specific case studies to help attendees learn how to navigate sticky situations including:
Managing multiple interviews/competing offers
Getting responses from unresponsive hiring managers
Ghosting from hiring managers or recruiters
Giving requirements to recruiters that will actually result in them calling you with new opportunities
Speeding up a slow interview process
Getting important but hard-to-ask questions answered in an interview
Negotiating the best compensation in the offer stage
Declining an offer while keeping all bridges in tact
Q&A for attendees' specific situations

sessions.title: Extending Power BI with Power Automate
sessions.description:
Automation is designed to simplify how you perform tasks every day.  You probably have noticed the Power Automate icon in the Power BI visualization pane, but probably struggle to understand how it works.  Believe it or not, there are some use cases that would streamline processes and make the process of managing your data easier.  

If you have ever wondered how you could integrate Power Automate with Power BI and Fabric, then this session is for you!  We will walk through the basics of Power BI actions within Power Automate, how to integrate these actions within a Power BI report, and review use cases that help you extend automation to simplify your life. 

At the end of this session, you will feel comfortable with integrating Power Automate into your Power BI reports.  You will even learn about the only acceptable use case for exporting data into Excel from a Power BI report!

sessions.title: Learn the basics of Git and GitHub workflow
sessions.description: In this presentation, I cover the essentials of setting up and configuring Git for efficient version control. I show how to install and use the posh-git module, a versatile Git integration for PowerShell. I illustrate the Git and GitHub Workflow, covering concepts like repositories, commits, and pull requests, and show how they all fit together. I discuss the process of forking a repository and cloning it to your local machine. This essential skill will enable you to contribute to projects and collaborate effectively with others.

sessions.title: Microsoft Fabric and Azure Health Data Services
sessions.description:
Bringing together diverse health data sources is essential for delivering healthcare solutions. Microsoft Fabric and Azure Health Data Services make it possible to integrate, manage, and analyze this data within a single platform to support patient care, claims processing, provider targeting, and more.

First, we'll explore the challenges in accessing and harmonizing various healthcare data types, highlighting how gaps in information can limit effective claims management, provider targeting, and timely interventions.

Next, we'll dive into how Fabric's advanced analytics capabilities enable the import and transformation of complex health datasets, including claims data and social determinants of health (SDOH).

Finally, we'll cover Azure Health Data Services' tools for securely exporting and managing health data, enhancing patient outreach, and supporting analytics for provider performance and network optimization. We'll see how combining Fabric's analytics with these services supports proactive care management, efficient claims handling, and strategic provider targeting.

Attendees will leave with a clear plan to use Microsoft Fabric and Azure Health Data Services for comprehensive healthcare data integration and analytics, enabling better patient care, improved claims processing, and effective provider engagement.

sessions.title: Using Digital Forensics for Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
sessions.description:
In an era defined by pervasive digital interactions, safeguarding organizational data has become paramount. This session delves into the intricate realm of Digital Forensics and its pivotal role in fortifying Data Loss Prevention (DLP) strategies.

 Through a blend of practical insights and theoretical underpinnings, participants will be guided through the labyrinth of digital security threats(Steganography for instance). From the perils posed by intruders to the latent risks of disgruntled employees, we will illuminate the vulnerabilities that permeate modern computing environments.

Moreover, attendees will gain firsthand knowledge of the arsenal of tools wielded by forensic experts to unearth clandestine activities. By demystifying the science behind digital investigations and infusing it with the artistry of forensic analysis, this session equips participants with actionable strategies to thwart data breaches and preserve organizational integrity.

 
Join us as we embark on a comprehensive exploration of Digital Forensics and its transformative potential in fortifying organizational resilience against the ever-evolving threat landscape of the digital age.

 

 

Prerequisites:

Some Database internals, some IT Security knowledge

sessions.title: Modeling Software Development Problems in Time and Thinking Temporally
sessions.description: "What did our membership look like on January 15th of this year? How many customers were active last year at this time? How many are active today? We must run a trade-show day-only coupon from 8 am to 5 pm next week!" These are real-world questions for a developer and data modeler. They are all easily answered using a Temporal Data Model. A Temporal entity changes over time, and business processes require the history and future of the item to be queried with ease. The following tech talk will provide a real-world use case and present the simplicity and power of temporally designed entities using SQL. You will despise "Start Date" and "End Date" after this talk.

sessions.title: Keynote - Artificial Intelligence: The Tale of Two Interns
sessions.description: Dr. Davis explores the evolving role of AI in the technology field through an experience-driven comparison of two interns. We will discuss where AI shines, where it still falls short, and what this means for data professionals mentoring the next generation in an increasingly automated world. Whether you're skeptical or excited about AI, this session will challenge how you think about work, learning, and leadership in the age of intelligent machines.

sessions.title: PrAIctical Engineering
sessions.description:
In today's dynamic tech environment, the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into practical engineering frameworks is reshaping our approach to technology and collaboration. This discussion introduces the concept of "PrAIctical Engineering," emphasizing a shift from building for certainty to building for verification and collaboration.
 
We'll cover various projects and applications, highlighting their roles in this innovative framework. Attendees will gain insights into the nuances of application-to-application interactions, focusing on the significance of structure and probability in creating reliable systems. These projects demonstrate the use of hard-lined schemas and dynamic processes to achieve emergent structures, exemplifying the balance between control and exposure in AI applications.
 
This discussion will also address the responsible use of AI and the critical role of human expertise in verifying AI-driven probabilities. By examining these frameworks, we aim to foster a collaborative environment where failure is anticipated and managed through verification, enhancing reliability and encouraging innovation in the face of uncertainty.
 
Join us as we delve into the practical engineering of AI technologies, offering a fresh perspective on collaboration and adaptability in today's tech landscape.

sessions.title: Mastering Microsoft Fabric Data Warehousing: Tips & Tricks You Need to Know
sessions.description:
During this session, we’ll dive into a range of helpful tips and tricks that I wish I had known when starting out with Microsoft Fabric data warehouses. These insights are designed to save you time, optimize performance, and make managing your data warehouse more efficient.

We’ll start by exploring a clever trick to create a case-insensitive warehouse using a simple API call, a small adjustment that can have a significant impact on query consistency and usability. From there, we’ll tackle performance monitoring, focusing on identifying and addressing slow queries. You’ll learn how to leverage built-in tools and techniques to pinpoint bottlenecks and take corrective action.

But what happens when a rogue query threatens to cripple your capacity? Don’t worry, we’ll cover how to detect and kill capacity-destroying queries before they disrupt operations. This critical skill will ensure your data warehouse remains stable and responsive, even under heavy workloads.

Throughout the session, I’ll share practical, real-world examples and actionable strategies to help you get the most out of Microsoft Fabric. Whether you’re new to data warehousing or looking to sharpen your skills, this session is packed with valuable insights you can start using immediately.

sessions.title: Careers in IT Baton Rouge 2025
sessions.description: Careers in IT will feature a panel of industry leaders and experts who directly interact with participants in a moderated question and answer session. This will allow participants to gain insight into what the IT community sees as valuable (skill-sets, certifications, experience, and etc) so that they can be better prepared for a career transition or to start work in the IT field for the first time.

sessions.title: Don't Bash PowerShell
sessions.description: Some administrators, especially those who come from a Linux background, try to use PowerShell like a Bash shell. While this will work, it is better to use the power behind PowerShell to accomplish what you are trying to accomplish. Let's take a look at some comparable commands and learn why the object model of PowerShell will make you more effective and able to accomplish more with less time and effort.

sessions.title: The Developer Testing Toolbox
sessions.description: Software testing is a vital skill for any developer who wants to deliver high-quality, reliable software. This session will explore unit testing and more advanced topics, such as mocking, integration tests, and mutation testing. It will also show tools and packages that can help you automate your testing process and make it more productive. Now includes .NET Aspire examples!

sessions.title: The Rise of AI Agents: What You Need to Know
sessions.description: This session offers a technical introduction to AI agents—autonomous systems capable of perceiving, reasoning, and acting toward defined goals. We’ll break down the essential components of an AI agent, including planning, memory management, tool use, and feedback loops. The talk will also explore emerging architectures, multi-agent collaboration patterns, and future trends in agentic systems. A live demo will showcase a simple agent built with current frameworks to illustrate practical implementation.

sessions.title: Automate Your Documentation with Local AI
sessions.description:
In this intermediate-level session, you'll discover how to use AI models running locally on your machine to take control of your documentation. We'll demonstrate how to leverage Ollama, a powerful tool for running large language models offline, to automatically generate and update README.md files and other documentation whenever changes are detected in your codebase.

Through a live demo, you'll see:
Setting up a local AI model with Ollama
Creating a script to generate documentation using AI
Integrating with Git to trigger updates on code commits
Watching documentation update in real-time as changes are made

This session is ideal for tinkerers, hobbyist, developers who want to save time, ensure consistency, and eliminate the hassle of manual documentation. We'll also discuss other potential use cases and how you can adapt this approach to your own projects.

sessions.title: SQL Server 2025: an enterprise AI-ready database platform
sessions.description:
Come learn about the latest release of Microsoft SQL Server, SQL Server 2025, with AI built-in, powered by industry proven security, performance, and availability, and connected and integrated to Azure and Microsoft Fabric. SQL Server 2025 provides a unique opportunity to build AI applications on-premises only or connect to the cloud. Learn how AMD EPYC™ CPUs bring compelling performance and value to your SQL Server 2025 deployments and AI workloads.

 

SQL is the only database to provide consistent AI capabilities ground to cloud to fabric. Come learn about all the new features of SQL Server 2025 including new capabilities specifically designed for the modern database developer.

sessions.title: README.md? We Can Do Better!
sessions.description: The venerable README file has a long history going back to at least the 1970s. Nowadays, when all code lives on Github it is basically a standard. README files are great and we all encourage more use of them except...can we do better? In this session we'll explore some other supported README formats and make a recommendation that yes, indeed, we can.

sessions.title: Building Scalable Data Warehouses with Microsoft Fabric:
sessions.description: Learn how to design and implement scalable data warehouses using Microsoft Fabric. This session will cover best practices for data storage, management, and retrieval, as well as the use of Fabric's data warehousing features. Attendees will gain insights into creating efficient data pipelines, optimizing performance, and ensuring data consistency.

sessions.title: Cutting Through the Buzz: LLM, Agents, RAG, and GPT - Making Sense of Generative AI
sessions.description: Join us for an introductory session about Generative AI! In this session, we will "Cut Through the Buzz" and demystify LLM, Agents, RAG, and GPT. We will discover how these technologies work behind the scenes with live demos in Databricks showcasing their practical applications. Whether you're new to AI or looking to expand your understanding, we'll dive into details and show you how to leverage these tools effectively. Join us to explore, ask questions, and leave with a clearer perspective on how Generative AI can transform your projects.

sessions.title: Röck Yoür Cäreer: Time-Tested Wisdom from a 30-Year Software Engineering Veteran
sessions.description:
Join me for an engaging and transformative conference session where I’ll share powerful insights from over three decades of experience as a software engineer, along with 18 years as a university educator. With a deep passion for empowering the next generation of tech professionals, I’ve maintained a thriving blog, authored multiple software engineering books since the ‘90s, and hold a patent for innovative technology solutions. Additionally, I’ve facilitated a dynamic, award-winning user group for more than two decades, fostering a community of lifelong learners and industry leaders.

In this session, I’ll provide a roadmap to success based on my rich career journey. You’ll gain practical advice on essential topics, including:
•	Mastering effective learning strategies to stay ahead in an ever-evolving industry
•	Achieving the elusive work-life balance while thriving professionally
•	Navigating the conference circuit to build lasting connections
•	Leveraging your strengths and unique contributions for career advancement
•	Prioritizing well-being to fuel long-term success and happiness

You’ll leave with actionable steps to help you accelerate your career, make meaningful professional connections, and live a more fulfilling tech life. With a commitment to nurturing the growth of engineers and technologists, I’m here to inspire and guide you toward an exciting future. Bring your notebook, because this session is packed with game-changing advice that will shape your career for years to come. Get ready to be inspired, motivated, and optimistic about what’s next in your tech journey!

sessions.title: Getting Super Geeky with PowerShell Notebooks - It's Easy!
sessions.description:
How easy is it for you to do things like share code with your teammates, get them to use your tools/scripts, or onboard new employees, especially if they may not be as experienced with PowerShell as you? 

Good news everyone, there's an easier way to do this!

PowerShell can leverage Notebooks - self-contained files which can contain not only code, but previous executions of the code.  These notebooks can be hugely beneficial in easing the load of making sure that code works in different locations, including pipelines, and without worrying about things like a profile or extra pre-requisites outside of the code.

Although these notebooks were primarily built for data science usage, as proficient PowerShell enthusiasts, we are used to being flexible with making tools work for how we need them to work.

Even better, these notebooks also only need a platform with the capabilities of using their features, which for us is just VSCode and a simple extension.

Let's show everyone how easy it is to edit & execute code, deal with self-contained variables, run these in a pipeline, and use this as a documentation & training tool.

sessions.title: Intro to Angular
sessions.description: If you are new to Angular, or still working on an older version, then it’s time to catch up with Angular 19. In this session, we will review a simple Single Page Application (SPA) built with the Angular 19 framework, TypeScript and Bootstrap. We will also look at the Angular Command Line Interface (CLI), used to create and manage Angular applications.

sessions.title: SQL Server Hosting on AWS: Options and Considerations
sessions.description: Are you planning to host SQL Server workloads on AWS or looking to optimize your existing deployment? This session provides a comprehensive overview of SQL Server hosting options on AWS and crucial considerations for successful implementation. We'll explore various deployment models including Amazon EC2, Amazon RDS for SQL Server, and AWS Managed Services, along with their respective benefits and trade-offs.

sessions.title: Connecting Power BI to API using POST
sessions.description: Power Query in Power BI provides access to a variety of data sources, including web pages.  Connecting to an API using an API (as in Restful API) is straightforward. You pass in a URL and you get a result. But many APIs require you to POST data and headers as part of the call to the API (eg. SPARQL requests).  How can you connect to such an API in Power Query?  I will demonstrate using a USA government API how easy it is to POST data and get the results.  This session focuses on creating the request and getting the data.  The sample report available for download will provide hints on how to parse the results.

sessions.title: Let’s Hack a Database
sessions.description:
Let's cover the basics of SQL Injections. This hands-on session shows how a cyber attacker can leverage misconfigurations to steal critical data from a web application. 

We'll cover some other considerations and implementations to mitigate SQL security vulnerabilities.

sessions.title: Natural Language Queries with ASP.NET
sessions.description:
Imagine if your users could just ask your app for the data they want—no complex menus, no cryptic filters, and definitely no waiting on IT for a custom report. In this session, I'll demonstrate how I built a dynamic ASP.NET (ASPX) page that acts as a translator between human language and your database.
We'll walk through the end-to-end process:
•	Natural Language Request: An end user types a plain-English data question.
•	AI-Powered Translation: The request (plus a schema doc) gets sent to the LLM API, which generates SQL on the fly.
•	Real-Time Data Access: The app runs the generated query and displays live results—all in a matter of seconds!
You'll see how to wire up an ASP.NET front end to the OpenAI API, securely execute AI-generated SQL, and show results back to the user. 
Whether you’re curious about AI integration, tired of static reporting, or just want to see what happens when SQL meets GPT, this session is for you. Come with questions—maybe you’ll leave with fewer of them (and a lot more answers).

sessions.title: Secure Communication Protocol for Distributed Environments
sessions.description:
This presentation introduces a novel lightweight security protocol specifically designed for distributed environments with resource-constrained devices. As the IoT landscape expands toward 29 billion connected devices by 2030, traditional security protocols like TLS present significant limitations, consuming substantial portions of available RAM on constrained devices and increasing power consumption during handshakes.
Our protocol optimizes cryptographic operations for IoT deployments where many devices operate with minimal RAM. The approach reduces handshake completion time to 78.4 milliseconds on resource-constrained devices—significantly faster than TLS 1.3 (132.7ms) and TLS 1.2 (187.5ms). Total message size averages just 826 bytes, representing a substantial reduction compared to TLS 1.3 (1,340 bytes) and TLS 1.2 (1,720 bytes), critical for bandwidth-constrained networks where transmission efficiency directly impacts power consumption.
The protocol demonstrates remarkable resource efficiency with lower memory usage (18.6KB vs. 27.3KB for TLS 1.3) and reduced CPU utilization (3.2% vs. 5.1% for TLS 1.3), addressing critical constraints in environments where security operations can represent a major portion of CPU utilization during cryptographic processing. Field testing confirms reduced energy consumption over TLS 1.3, extending battery life for the numerous IoT devices operating on batteries with expected 3-5 year lifespans.
Security analysis confirms robust protection against all threat vectors in our model, with formal verification confirming security properties across 15,728 potential attack states. The protocol maintains a high successful handshake rate in environments with packet loss—crucial for field deployments experiencing network disruption during normal operation.
This presentation demonstrates how our protocol resolves the fundamental tension between security requirements and resource constraints in modern distributed environments, enabling secure communication without compromising device performance or battery life.

sessions.title: Squeezing the Apple for All Its Juice
sessions.description: An introduction to OpenCore Legacy Patcher, a boot loader that enables older, unsupported Macs to run the latest macOS. Apple has an intentionally short support window for their machines and just announced that macOS 26 Tahoe will be the last to include support for Intel Macs. Unfazed, OCLP stands by, ready to breathe new life into your old dusty Macs occupying the far corners of your closet.

sessions.title: Common SQL Server Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
sessions.description: Making mistakes is natural, but learning from them and avoiding them in future takes effort. There's no substitute for experience or the shared wisdom of others to help you learn what mistakes to avoid. In this session, Tim will share with you a ton of what he's learned over the years from working and consulting at multiple Fortune-level companies. You'll hear about real-world environments he has worked on where there was a high impact from administrators making mistakes in how SQL Server was configured and administered. You'll learn many proven and accepted best practices for installing, configuring and supporting SQL Server to help your environment run as smoothly as possible and you'll leave with a checklist of items to take home to make sure your SQL Server environment is configured properly.

sessions.title: Unlocking Insights using Natural Language on Databricks Genie Spaces
sessions.description:
This session will introduce attendees to Genie Spaces, Databricks' innovative solution for transforming natural language questions into actionable data insights. 

Participants will learn how to configure a Genie Space by integrating datasets, crafting sample queries, and writing powerful instructions to guide AI understanding. 

Discover how Genie Spaces utilize table metadata, SQL functions, and previous interactions to generate meaningful responses. 

We will also explore real-world use cases, best practices for creating effective spaces, and how Genie continuously improves through user interactions.

Target Audience: Business users, data analysts, and IT professionals interested in leveraging AI-driven data analytics without extensive coding knowledge.

sessions.title: Tales from the SWAMP: Navigating the Murky Waters of Project Management
sessions.description:
TOPIC DESCRIPTION 

Get ready to experience project management through a unique lens of the mysterious and mystical Louisiana swamps! Just like a daring expedition into the unknown, project management often feels like wading through waist-deep mud, encountering unexpected obstacles at every turn. But fear not! By integrating the timeless structure of the Hero's Journey and the project management knowledge domains, we'll uncover how to emerge victorious from the depths of the swamp, armed with the tools to conquer any project-related challenge that lurks in the shadows. So, grab your virtual mosquito repellent and prepare to go on an unconventional and uproarious expedition! Together, we'll discover that with a dash of humor, a sprinkle of storytelling, and a whole lot of project management prowess, we can emerge from the swamp unscathed and ready to conquer any challenge that slithers our way! 

Learning Objectives
Navigate the Unknown: Recognize the parallels between project management and the Hero’s Journey to manage uncertainty with confidence.

Tame the Swamp Beasts: Analyze project challenges using PM knowledge domains to build resilience and readiness.

Pack the Right Gear: Apply storytelling as a tool for effective communication and stakeholder engagement.

Find the Hidden Path: Translate swampy setbacks into strategic success through adaptive project management approaches.

Return Transformed: Build confidence and capability to lead projects with humor, creativity, and grit.

sessions.title: Mastering Cursor: We're All Cooked (But in a Good Way)
sessions.description:
Cursor represents the future of software development. Instead of writing every line of code yourself, you’ll be more like a master chef, calling the shots, directing your AI sous-chefs, and orchestrating the entire kitchen to bring your ideas to life. In this session, I’ll show you how I’m using Cursor to build real, production-level applications by leveraging its most powerful capabilities, including custom rules and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Whether you’re new to Cursor or think you’ve seen it all, I promise there’ll be at least one moment where you’ll say, “Wait… it can do that?”

This talk is equal parts technical deep dive and creative inspiration. Bring your curiosity, your questions, and your appetite for what’s next, because by the end of this session, we’ll all be just a little more “cooked”… and that’s a good thing.

sessions.title: SQL Server Configuration Best Practices
sessions.description: Ever wondered why SQL Server can be slow when the engine is just installed and left at default settings? Ever wonder what goes into figuring out what to set the settings to and which ones to change? This session will take you through many settings that I would change and what they do to get SQL Server running better. The best part is you will get an explanation of each of the settings and why they should change. I will cover the engine, OS, TempDB, features, Database Settings and as much as we can cram into 60 mninutes. Join me for a fast paced very informative session that you can use NOW. See you there.

sessions.title: Managing SQL Server with Azure Arc Unleashed
sessions.description:
Take control of your SQL Server investment - wherever it lives! 

In this session, we’ll dive into the power of SQL Server enabled by Azure Arc, bringing Azure’s management capabilities to your on-premises, edge, and multicloud environments. 
Discover how to unify your SQL Server instances under one Azure-powered roof, from data centers to retail edge sites, with centralized inventory, security, and governance—all powered through automatic connectivity.

We’ll unpack features like SQL Server auto-registration with Azure Arc via the Azure Arc agent, supporting both direct and proxy connectivity modes for ultimate flexibility. Explore Microsoft Entra ID authentication for next-level security, Microsoft Defender for Cloud to squash security vulnerabilities, and pay-as-you-go licensing to tame dynamic workloads. 

Learn how to effortlessly connect and manage monster SQL Server deployments - across Windows and beyond. This session will give practical insights, real-world scenarios, and best practices to drive your hybrid SQL Server strategy.

Top Takeaways: 
* How to centralize management of SQL Server across hybrid and multicloud setups 
* Steps to lock down security with Microsoft Entra ID and Defender for Cloud 
* Assess Azure migration readiness leveraging SQL Server enabled by Azure Arc 
* Monitoring and governing SQL Server deployments
* Manage licensing and billing of SQL Server enabled by Azure Arc
* Leveraging Best Practices Assessment for SQL Server enabled by Azure Arc

sessions.title: CRZYFUN with 1000's of APIs
sessions.description: In this rapid-fire session, we’ll spotlight brilliant system and software architecture strategies that make managing thousands of APIs not just possible—but powerful. From modular design to resilient integration patterns, discover how top architects tame complexity, boost performance, and future-proof their ecosystems in minutes.

sessions.title: Narrative as a Design Tool
sessions.description:
This session explores the power of storytelling as a design tool, showing how narrative can create more meaningful and engaging user experiences. 

By integrating storytelling into the design process, designers can provide context, clarify complex processes, and align stakeholders around a shared vision. Storytelling fosters empathy, streamlines decision-making, and encourages collaboration throughout development. Participants will learn key strategies for crafting compelling narratives, including understanding audience goals, using techniques like mind mapping and storyboarding, ensuring a strong narrative flow, and incorporating feedback for continuous improvement. 

Additionally, the session emphasizes the importance of developing rich, relatable personas that ground the design in real-world user concerns and values.

sessions.title: The T-SQL JSON Operators
sessions.description: Officer Reese, someone got semi-structured data in my relational! No worries; let's look at the various T-SQL functions we can use to query and create JSON data within SQL Server!  Some of these functions are new for SQL Server 2022 and Azure SQL.

sessions.title: Getting Started Getting Started with Containerization
sessions.description:
Containerization know-how is undoubtedly one of the most important skills for anyone in a software engineering role. In my 10+ years of internal and external consulting, I've taught and coached engineers of all flavors (software, quality, site reliability, product, and more) on how to use containerization to build, test, and run code in modern cloud-native environments. To use containerization effectively, you need to understand how to run products like Docker and also how they work both on your machine and in the cloud.

In this talk, we'll introduce an easy mental model for understanding how containerization works at a conceptual and technical level, demonstrate why and how it is an important strategy to apply to your software development lifecycle, and show examples of how containerization is being used on engineering computers, cloud providers, edge devices, and more. Whether you are starting your containerization journey or have a team you want to shift into modern cloud-native software development, this talk will provide you with the talking points and materials you need to push and pull your way through!

sessions.title: Agentic AI in Construction – Transforming the Industry with Intelligent Solutions
sessions.description:
The rapid evolution of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping industries at an unprecedented pace, and the construction sector is no exception. This paper explores the growing role of Agentic AI in construction, emphasizing its potential to enhance efficiency, streamline workflows, and drive intelligent decision-making. Unlike traditional AI, Agentic AI systems proactively initiate actions, plan strategically, adapt through continuous learning, and collaborate with other agents to address complex construction challenges.

The study delves into key applications of Agentic AI in construction, including contract management, compliance verification, document processing, procurement optimization, labor productivity tracking, scheduling, and predictive analytics. These intelligent agents can autonomously manage tasks such as dynamic project scheduling, real-time risk assessment, issue resolution, and resource allocation—reducing delays, minimizing costs, and improving project outcomes.

Furthermore, we explore how Agentic AI integrates multimodal data from various sources (text, images, 3D models, IoT sensors) to provide granular insights into construction operations. This capability enables more accurate forecasting, efficient material delivery planning, automated compliance monitoring, and adaptive learning to continuously improve processes over time.

By embracing Agentic AI, construction firms can unlock new levels of operational efficiency, enhance decision-making, and foster a culture of innovation. This presentation offers key takeaways on how technology leaders can leverage Agentic AI to gain a competitive advantage and drive the digital transformation of the construction industry.

In my 25+ years at Microsoft, I have taught many workshops on scripting, debugging, and advanced troubleshooting. Using my scripting expertise, I created tools to help customers collect and analyze data used to support and optimize their environments.

You can find my blog and presentations at https://sdwheeler.github.io/seanonit

Sravanthi Reddy is a seasoned Senior .NET Developer with over 10 years of experience building robust web applications and services using Microsoft technologies at Atalanta,Georgia. With a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology from JNTU University, she has established herself as a versatile full-stack developer with expertise in both front-end and back-end development.
Sravanthi currently works at Truist Financial in Atlanta, where she leads development teams in migrating applications and services while implementing best practices for security and performance optimization. Her technical arsenal includes C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core, MVC, WEB API, and WCF. On the front-end, she excels in modern JavaScript frameworks including Angular 13 and ReactJS, creating responsive and intuitive user interfaces.
Throughout her career spanning organizations like USAA, Molina Healthcare, and Walmart, Sravanthi has consistently demonstrated her ability to architect and implement complex enterprise solutions. She has extensive experience with cloud platforms including Azure and AWS, and is proficient in microservices architecture and containerization using Docker and Kubernetes.
Sravanthi's approach to software development is guided by SOLID principles and design patterns, with a focus on creating scalable, maintainable applications. She is skilled in implementing various authentication methods and ensuring application security. Her database expertise includes SQL Server, where she optimizes queries and designs efficient data storage solutions.
As a technical lead, Sravanthi coordinates with offshore teams, manages code reviews, and mentors junior developers. She is well-versed in Agile methodologies and modern DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines using tools like Azure DevOps and Jenkins.
Sravanthi combines her technical prowess with strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, making her an asset for organizations looking to leverage Microsoft technologies for business-critical applications.

Srikanth Kumar Rana is a seasoned Field Engineer at Databricks, bringing extensive experience in helping organizations unlock the full potential of data and AI. With a strong focus on empowering customers, Srikanth has consistently demonstrated expertise in complex deployments, driving adoption, and enabling businesses to achieve tangible outcomes on the Databricks Lakehouse platform. 

Srikanth will guide attendees through the capabilities of Databricks Genie Spaces, demonstrating how natural language queries can revolutionize data analysis and visualization.

Steven Judd is a 30+ year IT Pro and most recently an [Infrastructure Engineer at Tenstreet LLC.](https://www.linkedin.com/in/stevenjudd/).
His previous recent experience includes Enterprise Email Administrator, Digital Security Analyst, and Cloud and DevOps Advisor for cloud-focused solutions and infrastructure.
He has been using PowerShell since 2010 and co-developed a custom training program for PowerShell.
Most recently, he was a Senior Editor for the [Modern IT Automation with PowerShell](https://leanpub.com/modernautomationwithpowershell) book.
He is also a co-author and co-editor of the [PowerShell Conference Book 3](https://www.amazon.com/PowerShell-Conference-Book-3/dp/B08MGR749H/ref=sr_1_5)
He loves to help people learn and recognize the value of automation.
He spends his free time learning more about PowerShell, digital security, and cloud technologies, along with creating and telling [Dad jokes](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BZZM6i8AE1Y).
You can find him hanging out on the [PowerShell Discord Server](https://aka.ms/psdiscord), running marathons, cycling and mountain biking, playing the cello, plus a handful of other hobbies he can't seem to quit.
Please follow him on Twitter, [@stevenjudd](https://twitter.com/stevenjudd/), read his [blog](https://blog.stevenjudd.com/), and review, use, and improve his code on [Github](https://github.com/stevenjudd).

speakers.bio:
Tanya Boyd is a dynamic project manager and creative strategist with 20+ years of experience spanning disaster recovery, healthcare, IT, marketing, and government. 

As Director of Creative Collaboration at Corbeau and Project Success Academy, she blends imagination, strategy, and storytelling to spark bold programs, forge meaningful partnerships, and design content that drives long-term success.

A PMP® since 2014 and PMI-ACP® since 2020, Tanya also served as President and longtime leader of the PMI Baton Rouge Chapter - giving her a front-row seat to the evolving challenges project professionals face in becoming stronger, more human-centered leaders.

In 2024, she shifted gears into keynote speaking and educational video creation. She developed a 3-part communication video series for Project Success Academy and a 3-hour course - From Risks to Rewards - for the PURE Project Manager 60-PDU credential.

Tanya has delivered high-energy talks to 25+ PMI chapters on topics like generative AI, leadership, emotional intelligence, and workplace fears. Two crowd favorites: Thriving Beyond Fear and Tales from the SWAMP.

She is also a contributing author to the upcoming book Projectland Goes to the Movies: 25 Star-Studded Lessons for Project People.

She believes curiosity and communication unlock creative solutions - and that humor and storytelling are the secret sauce for unforgettable meetings. 

Off the clock, you’ll find her kayaking Louisiana’s swamps, camera in hand, chasing the next wild idea.
